notes:
HB SUPER APP 7.5 🚀

🎨 New premium look
- 🌙 Dark navy design, HB Blue accent, rounded cards and smooth animations
- 🎛️ Light, dark and system themes; clean English interface
- 🧭 New 5-tab navigation: Home, Downloads, Browser, Tools, Library

🌐 HB Browser (Chrome-style)
- 🧭 One top toolbar: lock icon + address pill, tab counter and three-dot menu
- 🏠 Chrome-style start page: HB logo, big search box and 8 shortcuts (visited sites included)
- 🗂️ Tab grid with thumbnails; normal and private tabs (private tabs are never saved or restored)
- 🕶️ Incognito dark purple theme and incognito chip in the toolbar
- 📜 Toolbar hides when you scroll down and returns when you scroll up
- ⬇️ Pull to refresh, find in page, reader mode, desktop mode, dark pages, text size
- ⭐ Bookmarks, 🕘 History, search engines (Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo/Yahoo) and download folder
- 🔗 Long-press a link or image: new tab, incognito tab, copy, download, share
- 🛡️ Ad/tracker blocking, SSL errors are never bypassed, pages cannot read local files

🎬 Browser video downloader (new)
- ⬇️ YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X/Twitter, Reddit, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Pinterest, Snapchat, Threads, Twitch, Likee, LinkedIn
- 🔵 Blue download button on video pages: Video / Audio (MP3) / Copy link
- 🎚️ Real quality picker before download (heights from yt-dlp, default quality as fallback)
- 🧲 Detects live .mp4 / .m3u8 / .mpd / .webm links; count badge on the button
- 📥 Download any detected file from the sheet; "Download all" for playlists and channels
- 🖼️ Small download icon on every <video>; works in feeds and shorts too
- 🍪 "Use browser login for downloads": the site's login is sent with the download (private tabs ask first; the cookie file is deleted after the download and never logged)
- 📋 Downloads started in the browser appear in the Downloads tab and the Home badge

🎬 Media Player
- ▶️ Video and music, queue/playlist, subtitles, speed and aspect ratio
- 🔒 Screen lock, gestures, PiP, background audio and resume

📁 Files and Library
- 🗃️ File Manager: search, sort, rename, copy, move, delete (confirm), ZIP, multi-select
- 🖼️ Library: videos, music, photos, recent playback and storage

🔄 Converter Studio
- 🎵 Video to MP3, audio convert, trim, compress, GIF
- 🖼️ Image convert/compress and Images to PDF

🧰 Smart tools
- 📷 QR scan/generate, 📄 PDF viewer, 🖼️ image viewer
- 🔔 Ringtone maker, 📋 clipboard link tool, 💾 storage analyzer, 🔍 file search, ✍️ text tools

🔐 Privacy
- 🚫 Browsing history is never uploaded
- 🛡️ Websites cannot read local files; SSL errors are never bypassed
- 🍪 Download cookie files live only in the cache and are deleted as soon as the download ends
- 📵 No Firebase keys or secrets in the app

⬆️ Updates
- 📥 Background APK download, Range resume, SHA-256 check, one-tap install
- 🔑 Same signing key and package, so it installs straight over 7.4
